mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, pool_id, relative_path, file_name, size_bytes, chunk_size, total_chunks, received_chunks, status, upload_id, bucket, final_key, error_msg, parts, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_task (tenant_id, pool_id, relative_path, file_name, size_bytes, chunk_size, total_chunks, received_chunks, status, upload_id, bucket, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{poolId}, #{relativePath}, #{fileName}, #{sizeBytes}, #{chunkSize}, #{totalChunks}, 0, #{status}, #{uploadId}, #{bucket}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: UPDATE upload_task SET parts = COALESCE(parts, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(CAST(#{partNumber} AS text), jsonb_build_object('partNumber', #{partNumber}, 'etag', #{etag})), received_chunks = received_chunks + 1 - (CASE WHEN jsonb_exists(COALESCE(parts, '{}'::jsonb), CAST(#{partNumber} AS text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} RETURNING received_chunks
mapper.update: UPDATE upload_task SET status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE upload_task SET status = #{status}, final_key = #{finalKey}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
